resources.string: Read or copy this analysis. The selected text will not be replaced.
Unlock your device to open AI provider settings.

Use your own API key. Keys are encrypted on this device and excluded from backups and exports. Cloud actions require a separate, explicit send from the text preview. Ordinary typing stays offline. API charges and the provider’s data policy apply.
A key is stored on this device.
Enter a key with at most 4,096 ASCII characters, without spaces or line breaks.
Could not access secure storage. Unlock the device and try again. If the stored key is damaged, delete it and enter it again. Secure keys require Android 6 or later.
Model saved. No API request was sent.
Hold space to open the wheel
Optional. Space swipes and custom popup keys keep their actions. Hold the language key to switch keyboards, or use Android’s keyboard switcher.
Customize your keyboard in the existing settings, then save a profile for each area. Applying a profile changes only that area.
Key style, borders and font size. Colors and custom themes remain available in Appearance.
Number row, emoji key and language key. Manage languages and custom layout files under Languages and layouts.
Horizontal and vertical space swipes and swipe-to-delete.
Reset this area to its defaults? Your saved profile is kept.
Replace the saved profile for this area with your current settings?
This profile could not be saved or applied. It may be damaged or belong to a different version.
Case and spacing tools work on your device. AI actions require a separate send. Tap a preview to expand it.
Select text in the app first, then open text actions.
Review the result before replacing your selection.
Empty result: applying removes the selected text.
The text or selection changed. Reopen text actions to start again.
Text actions are disabled in this protected field.
Finish typing or swiping, then select text.
The editor may have accepted the result. Check the text before doing anything else. Closing this panel may close the keyboard so it can reconnect.
%3$s: send the previewed selection (%2$d characters) to %4$s using %1$s? API charges and the provider’s data policy apply.
Action cancelled. No result will be inserted. A request already sent may still incur charges.
Set up your API key under AI providers, then reselect your text and start again.
The provider rejected this key or its permissions. Check AI providers, then start again.
The model or request was not accepted. Check the model ID under AI providers.
The provider’s rate or usage limit was reached. No retry was sent.
The request timed out. No retry was sent. A request already received may still incur charges.
The provider declined this action. No replacement is prepared.
The response was incomplete, invalid or too large. No replacement is prepared.
An earlier request is still stopping. Reopen the panel to try again.
The request failed. No retry was sent. Check your connection or provider and reopen the panel.

Assign actions to the three numbered keys and pin them to the toolbar. If the toolbar is hidden, enable it in Toolbar settings. Each key prepares a preview; AI still needs a separate Send. Language, tone and model come from AI provider settings.
Could not read or save these keys. Unlock the device and reopen this page. An invalid import leaves your configuration unchanged.
No skill is available for this key. Unlock the device or assign it under Skill keys in app settings.
Skill assignments imported. No action was executed.
Saved profile imported. Tap Apply saved to change the keyboard.
Export contains the three names and action assignments. Import replaces these three assignments, without changing pinned keys or running actions. API keys, text and results are excluded.
Up to 20 status records for seven days, encrypted on this device. Source texts and results are not retained. A restart never repeats a request or inserts text.
Action status could not be saved or read. No new request is sent if its initial status cannot be saved. You can delete the status records and try again.
Response received. Editor insertion is always a separate action; the response is not saved here.
Cancelled locally. The provider may already have processed the request.
Outcome unknown. No automatic retry or text insertion.
Combine local and AI text actions. Files contain configuration only. Saving or importing never executes an action.
The workflow could not be read or saved. Its configuration may have changed. Cancel the draft and refresh before editing again.
Activate %1$d imported workflows and replace the saved collection? This does not run any action.
Workflow configuration activated. No action was executed.
Choose a workflow. Nothing runs until you approve the complete sequence.
This sequence runs locally. Its result is only a preview; text insertion remains a separate action.
Up to %1$d model requests. The declared selection and intermediate results are sent to the providers above. API charges and provider data policies apply. Nothing is automatically inserted.
Running workflow… Nothing is automatically inserted.
This workflow requires a provider that is not available. No request was sent.
Workflow stopped: text or output exceeded its allowed limits. No partial result was inserted.
input has at least %1$d UTF-16 characters
When a condition is false, that step passes its input through unchanged and makes no model request.
Workflow finished: %1$d model requests, %2$d skipped steps.
Literal comparison, including case. No regular expressions.
The referenced workflow is unavailable. Import it or choose another in settings.
This key stores a workflow reference. Pressing it opens the current saved definition for separate approval. Workflow files are exported separately.
Up to %1$d steps and %2$d model requests. Text and time limits also apply.
Workflow finished. Inserting text is a separate action. Results are not retained here.
Builder response received. Saving a workflow is a separate action.
Delete the damaged workflow configuration and start with an empty list? Saved workflows will be lost. API keys, profiles and skill bindings are kept; workflow references may need reassignment.
Describe a text workflow using local transformations, AI text actions and conditions. Maximum 8 steps and 3 model calls.
This exact instruction and the fixed workflow format will be sent to OpenAI using the model shown. No editor selection is included. API usage may incur costs.
The builder is unavailable. Unlock the device and leave incognito mode before trying again.
Review every step and model before saving. This draft is not saved yet. Saving adds configuration; start the workflow separately from the keyboard.
Test tool (on this device): counts the characters, words and lines of the %1$d selected characters. Nothing leaves the keyboard and nothing is inserted.

Hand over to: the calendar app you choose (Android “new event” screen).
The keyboard does not save an event and cannot see whether you save one there.

Title: %1$s

Description (%2$d characters):
%3$s
Running tool… Nothing is automatically inserted.
Test tool finished on this device. The selected text is unchanged.
Handed over to the calendar app. The event is not saved until you save it there.
No app accepted the calendar draft. Nothing was handed over.
The tool failed. Nothing is repeated automatically.
This selection cannot be used with the tool.
Tool cancelled. Nothing was handed over.
Test tool finished on this device.
Handed over to another app. Whether anything was saved there is not known.
Enter a model ID for this provider under AI providers first.
Provider for the keyboard’s AI actions
The key and model below belong to the selected provider. Workflow steps name their own provider.
No model is preset for this provider. Enter the model ID from the provider’s documentation.
